title: The Best Ticketing Sites to Find Affordable Concert Tickets Online
summary: Whether you're a fan of pop, rock, country or all of the above, these resale retailers have discounted tickets to concerts — especially with Shop Billboard's exclusive promo codes.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Although the year is more than halfway finished, yhere’s still a long list of music events and concerts going on in 2026, from Las Vegas residencies to K-pop groups traveling to the United States for concert dates.

No matter what kind of music you’re into, there’s an upcoming concert that you’d want to attend. Unfortunately, tickets to events can be costly. But luckily, there are a number of third-party resale retailers that usually have ongoing deals and promos that give fans the option to score cheap concert tickets.

And, Shop Billboard has exclusive promo codes that’ll make those ticket prices for upcoming concerts and festivals a little cheaper and even sweeter.

What Are the Best Cheap Ticket Sites Online?

First of all, tickets to popular tours first go on sale through Live Nation and Ticketmaster , so these are the two best retailers to get tickets first. In fact, Ticketmaster has the “ Face Value Exchange ” program for fans to resell tickets to other fans.

Shop Concert Tickets at Ticketmaster

However, whether you’re on the hunt for last-minute tickets to Harry Styles’ residency at Madison Square Garden , or just need some weekend plans, these ticket sites usually come with protected sales featuring lower prices. Before you make your purchase, check the retailer’s buyer’s guarantee policy to see how your purchases are protected.

Note: All the promo codes and discounted savings listed above were live at time of this article’s publication but prices could change at anytime.

EDITOR'S PICK

StubHub

Buy Tickets at StubHub

Top choice for concert tickets in 2026.

StubHub has all-in pricing, so all fees are listed upfront. The site’s “FanProtect Guarantee” ensures that tickets are valid and delivered in time for the concert. If not, you’ll get your money back. Additionally, if the concert is canceled and not rescheduled, you’ll receive 120% credit, or be offered a full refund without the extra credit.

SUPER SELLERS

Vivid Seats

Buy Tickets at Vivid Seats

Vivid Seats lets you search by type of seat, such as suite, standing room, front of section or the VIP section, while the retailer prioritizes “Super Sellers” who are “experienced, highly-rated sellers.” With Vivid Seats , your purchase is protected with the company’s “100% Buyer Guarantee,” which ensures that you receive legitimate tickets in time for your concert, or your money back.

TRUSTPILOT APPROVED

SeatGeek

buy tickets at SeatGeek

Tickets from SeatGeek are delivered digitally via email, so they’re available on your phone before you go through security. And prices are surprisingly reasonable, even for the hottest tickets. You can use our discount code BILLBOARD10 to save an additional $10 at checkout.

NO HIDDEN FEES

TicketNetwork

Buy tickets at TicketNetwork

TicketNetwork has various ticket packages available, which include parking passes, VIP access, meet and greets and other great experiences. It has tickets to concerts with all-in pricing that lets you see exactly what you’ll pay up front (fees included). You can use our exclusive code BILLBOARD150 to save $150 off purchases over $500, or BILLBOARD300 to save $300 off orders of $1000 and up.

And since TicketNetwork is a resale site, the company says that pricing may sometimes be below face value because tickets aren’t held to a specific price point. It guarantees that the tickets you receive are the ones you purchased, and sometimes, even better than expected.

BEST FOR SPORTS

Gametime

Buy Tickets at Gametime

Gametime is a stellar third-party retailer for fans looking for affordable tickets. Tickets for in-demand concerts. It guarantees the lowest prices, event cancellation protection and on-time ticket delivery for a smooth ticket buying experience. Plus, if it’s your first time using the seller, you can get $20 off purchases of over $150 when you enter the code SAVE20 at checkout.

BEST FOR BROADWAY SHOWS

TodayTix

Buy Tickets at TodayTix

TodayTix is the destination online to go to if you’re on the hunt for last-minute, wallet-friendly Broadway tickets. The site offers everything from plays, Broadway musicals, off-Broadway shows, comedies and select concerts. The site’s deals and offers page shows you the “hottest deals,” including offers that can save you up to 40% off list prices. When you click on a show, the calendar shows you the lowest prices for each day available.

BEST FOR INTERNATIONAL CONCERTS

Viagogo

Buy Tickets at Viagogo

In you want to get tickets for a concert in another country, then Viagogo is one of the largest reselling sites and provides a place where sellers can go to resell tickets. For buyers, the brand uses security checks to ensure that transactions go smoothly and tickets being sold are legit.
